# On android a Column the generated code writes rather than a vbox -- a
# window's content arriving through a slot, a nav page of several nodes --
# gives a flexing child its share of the Column, as a vbox does: the Column
# provides it through Compose (LocalFlexShare), since a slot's content is
# composed where the slot is invoked. Before, such a child read the screen's
# share, fillMaxSize, and pushed `bottom` off the screen.
#
# `slot.sngl` and `page.sngl` snapshot each route; `slot_shown.sngl` and
# `page_shown.sngl` write the same nodes in a ui.vbox, and each pair must be
# one picture.

env SNGL_UPDATE_SNAPSHOTS=1

sngl test --platform=android --opt testRunner=robolectric slot.sngl
stdout 'ok   1 tests, 0 failures'
sngl test --platform=android --opt testRunner=robolectric slot_shown.sngl
stdout 'ok   1 tests, 0 failures'
cmp slot.sngl.snapshots/robolectric/shown.png slot_shown.sngl.snapshots/robolectric/shown.png

sngl test --platform=android --opt testRunner=robolectric page.sngl
stdout 'ok   1 tests, 0 failures'
sngl test --platform=android --opt testRunner=robolectric page_shown.sngl
stdout 'ok   1 tests, 0 failures'
cmp page.sngl.snapshots/robolectric/shown.png page_shown.sngl.snapshots/robolectric/shown.png

-- slot.sngl --
import test "sngl:test"
import ui "sngl:ui"

var details = true

func testShown(t test.Test) {
    t.snapshot("shown")
}

if details {
    ui.window(title="Flex") {
        ui.text(value="top")
        ui.scroll(style={flex=1}) {
            ui.text(value="grows")
        }
        ui.text(value="bottom")
    }
}
-- slot_shown.sngl --
import test "sngl:test"
import ui "sngl:ui"

var details = true

func testShown(t test.Test) {
    t.snapshot("shown")
}

if details {
    ui.window(title="Flex") {
        ui.vbox(style={flex=1}) {
            ui.text(value="top")
            ui.scroll(style={flex=1}) {
                ui.text(value="grows")
            }
            ui.text(value="bottom")
        }
    }
}
-- page.sngl --
import nav "sngl:ui/nav"
import test "sngl:test"
import ui "sngl:ui"

func testShown(t test.Test) {
    t.snapshot("shown")
}

ui.window(title="Flex") {
    nav.stack #pages {
        nav.page #home(href="/", title="Home") {
            ui.text(value="top")
            ui.scroll(style={flex=1}) {
                ui.text(value="grows")
            }
            ui.text(value="bottom")
        }
    }
}
-- page_shown.sngl --
import nav "sngl:ui/nav"
import test "sngl:test"
import ui "sngl:ui"

func testShown(t test.Test) {
    t.snapshot("shown")
}

ui.window(title="Flex") {
    nav.stack #pages {
        nav.page #home(href="/", title="Home") {
            ui.vbox(style={flex=1}) {
                ui.text(value="top")
                ui.scroll(style={flex=1}) {
                    ui.text(value="grows")
                }
                ui.text(value="bottom")
            }
        }
    }
}
